metadata.description: BUG-RELEASE-001: dependsOn was `<pkg>:build` only, never `<pkg>:dist-manifest`. `build` (@nx/js:tsc / the Vite build executor) unconditionally (re)writes its OWN minimal, un-rebased dist/package.json as a build output (see generate-manifest.js's writeDistManifest doc comment, BUG-BUILD-PUBLISH-DISTMANIFEST-CLOBBERED-001) — so invoking this gate via `build` alone actively CLOBBERS a previously-correct rebased manifest back to the broken source-relative shape and then reports it as failing. `dist-manifest` transitively depends on `build`+`assets` (tools/nx-plugins/build/plugin.js) and is the one function (writeDistManifest) that both `dist-manifest` and the real `nx-release-publish`/`publish` targets call to materialize a correct dist/package.json — depending on it here (not `build`) makes this diagnostic re-stamp the manifest the same way a real publish does, instead of undoing that stamp.

GATE 1 (pre-publish, offline): asserts every intra-@adhd/* dependency range in the release set resolves against {registry-published versions} ∪ {versions this release will publish}. Wired into `pnpm release`/`release:dry`; blocks publish on failure. See tools/nx-plugins/build/lib/range-resolvability.js.

GATE 2 (post-publish, end-to-end): npm-installs every publishable entrypoint from the real registry in an ephemeral dir + bin smoke, in parallel. See tools/nx-plugins/build/executors/smoke-test/clean-room-smoke.mjs.

BUG-ADHD-EE8D24C8-REVERT-001: flags a commit/range whose diff is dominated by deletions of files that already existed at HEAD/base (the proven shape of a stale working tree — e.g. after `git update-ref` moved a branch without updating its tree — committed back over already-fixed files). `.githooks/pre-commit` Gate 0 and `.githooks/post-commit` call the underlying `.githooks/detect-mass-deletion.js` directly (must run pre-node_modules-guaranteed); this target exists so CI/a server-side check can run the IDENTICAL classifier via `nx run @adhd/source:mass-delete-guard --base=<ref> --head=<ref>`, closing the local-hook `--no-verify` blind spot.
